home.emptyText: New products are coming soon. Please check back later.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may be wrong, or the page no longer exists. Open the shop's link or scan its QR code to visit it.
notFound.shopText: This product or page isn't here anymore. Take a look at what's in the shop now.

meta.description: Cosmetics and beauty products — see prices, sizes and shades, and order easily.

staff.title: Staff
staff.addHint: They sign in with this phone or email and password. Copy the password and send it to them.
staff.name: Name
staff.resetHint: New password for {name}. They will be signed out on every device.
staff.confirmDeactivate: They'll be signed out right away and can't sign in until you enable them again.
staff.empty: No users yet. Tap “Add user” to add the first one.
staff.deleteText: They'll be removed from this shop and signed out. Past orders stay as they are.
staff.deleteOwnerText: This owner account will be deleted and can't open any shop again. Past orders stay as they are.
staff.shopsHint: Tick the shops this person works in and pick their role in each. They switch shop from their user menu.

delivery.courierDeliveryHint: Send parcels with J&T or Vireak Buntham.

telegram.callbackStale: This order status has already changed.
telegram.telegramUserHint: Enter the numeric ID for the selected account. Leave blank to unlink it.
telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.intro: Send every new order to the shop's Telegram group so staff can pack it.
telegram.enabled: Send new orders to this group
telegram.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect this group? New orders will no longer be sent to it.

telegram.waitingHint: In Telegram, pick a group and tap to add the bot. This page updates by itself.
telegram.botNotSet: The bot isn't set up on the server (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN). Contact the app admin.
telegram.buttonAccessHint: Whoever connected the group is linked automatically. Add other staff below.

settings.appearanceHint: Your shop's logo and brand colour

settings.slugHint: The shop link will look like this: {link}
settings.slugLockedHint: Locked: customers already order through this link — {link}
